translations.web: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
translations.bsb: God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.
translations.kjv: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
